# Category: Crop Advisory
## Region: Madhya Pradesh > Sehore
**Source ID:** src_crop_advisories_Madhya Pradesh (Verified: 2026-10-02)

- **Advisory Text:** Harvest soybean when 90% of pods turn golden brown to prevent pod shattering. For incoming Rabi Chickpea, treat seeds with Trichoderma viride @ 5g/kg seed followed by Rhizobium culture to prevent wilt.
- **Crop Name:** Soybean / Chickpea (Gram)
- **Fertilizer Guidance:** Apply basal dose of DAP @ 40 kg/acre + Sulphur 10 kg/acre at chickpea sowing time.
- **Growth Stage:** Pod Maturity (Soybean) / Pre-sowing Seed Treatment (Gram)
- **Irrigation Guidance:** Give pre-sowing light irrigation (Palewa) for seed bed preparation for Rabi chickpea and mustard.
### Pest Disease Alerts
- Spodoptera litura (Tobacco Caterpillar) in late maturity soybean
- Dry root rot in chickpea
- **Season:** Kharif-Rabi Transition

# Category: Gov Schemes Loans
## Region: Madhya Pradesh > all
**Source ID:** src_gov_schemes_loans_Madhya Pradesh (Verified: 2026-10-02)

- **Benefits:** Short-term credit limit up to Rs. 3 Lakh at 7% basic interest rate, reduced to 4% effective interest upon prompt repayment (3% Prompt Repayment Incentive by Central Govt). RuPay Debit card issued with Rs. 1 Lakh personal accident cover.
- **Deadlines:** Open year-round; credit limit validity is 5 years with annual renewal.
### Documents
- Duly completed KCC Application Form
- Identity Proof: Aadhaar Card / Voter ID
- Land ownership papers: Latest Khasra and Khatauni certified copy
- No Dues Certificate or affidavit of existing loans from local banks
### Eligibility
- All farmers - individuals/joint borrowers who are owner cultivators
- Tenant farmers, oral lessees & share croppers
- SHGs or Joint Liability Groups of farmers
- **Helpline:** KCC Toll Free Helpline: 1800-11-5526 / Kisan Call Centre: 1800-180-1551
- **How To Apply:** Submit one-page simplified KCC form at nearest Commercial Bank, RRB, or District Central Cooperative Bank (DCCB) branch, or apply online through Jan Samarth portal.
- **Portal Link:** None
- **Scheme Name:** Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Crop Loan with Interest Subvention
- **Scheme Type:** Subsidized Credit

# Category: Imd Weather Advisory
## Region: Madhya Pradesh > Sehore
**Source ID:** src_imd_agromet_Madhya Pradesh (Verified: 2026-10-02)

- **Bulletin Date:** 2026-10-02
- **District:** Sehore

- **Spray Conditions:** Favorable for spray operations during morning hours (08:00 AM to 11:00 AM); avoid spraying during hot midday hours.

- **Valid Until:** 2026-10-05
